$comment: Single source of truth for the 25 operating levers. Read by app/ops/levers.ts (typed accessors) and by scripts/build-log.mjs (generates BUILD-LOG.md from real file mtimes). Adding a lever = add an entry here, create its files, re-run `npm run build-log`.

levers.title: Flat-rate task pricing, not hourly
levers.impact: Inverts the speed incentive. On T&M a fast tech earns you less.

levers.title: Raise prices 10% and measure close rate
levers.impact: +10% price on a 54% margin job is ~20% more gross profit.

levers.title: Good / Better / Best on every quote
levers.impact: Anchors high, shifts the mix up off the cheapest option.

levers.title: Two-hour minimum plus trip charge, enforced
levers.impact: Kills the $90 job that eats a three-hour round trip.

levers.title: Paid estimates over $5k, credited on signing
levers.impact: Filters tire-kickers; payers close at multiples of the rate.

levers.title: Maintenance plan on every mini split
levers.impact: 100 units under contract is $20k+/yr recurring at ~70% margin.

levers.title: Hold a 30% materials markup
levers.impact: $8-15k per tech per year that most shops give away.

levers.title: Sell the next job on the current job
levers.impact: Free 15-25% revenue. Highest-converting source in home services.

levers.title: Neighbour blitz after every job
levers.impact: Raises route density and cuts drive time at the same time.

levers.title: Bid the whole punch list, not the one item
levers.impact: One dispatch, ten line items, no extra drive.

levers.title: Be the after-hours provider
levers.impact: Premium rate, near-zero competition, instant PM loyalty.

levers.title: Get formally onto property-manager vendor lists
levers.impact: Boring paperwork competitors skip; becomes a dispatch queue.

levers.title: Free mini split suitability assessment as lead magnet
levers.impact: High intent, converts hot, puts you inside the house.

levers.title: Deposit on every job, e-signed on the spot
levers.impact: Kills the receivables problem before it exists.

levers.title: Same-day invoice, card on file, auto-charge
levers.impact: 30-day to 3-day DSO on $60k/mo frees ~$54k of working capital.

levers.title: Route density rule: 15 minutes between same-day jobs
levers.impact: 65% to 75% utilization is ~15% more revenue on identical payroll.

levers.title: Standardised truck stock, weekly restock
levers.impact: Supply-house runs cost 45-90 minutes each and are invisible.

levers.title: Photo pre-qualification before rolling a truck
levers.impact: Saves one to two wasted trips per tech per week.

levers.title: Batch mini split installs geographically
levers.impact: Two installs in one neighbourhood shares drive and equipment run.

levers.title: Distributor account instead of retail
levers.impact: 15-30% off equipment: $600-1,100 per multi-zone job.

levers.title: Audit workers' comp class codes
levers.impact: Misclassification quietly costs thousands a year.

levers.title: Hire tech #2 before you feel ready
levers.impact: Tech #1 nets $333/mo. Profit starts at tech #2.

levers.title: Fire the worst 10% of customers annually
levers.impact: Raise their price 30%: they leave or become profitable.

levers.title: One config-driven codebase for every trade and metro
levers.impact: New city is a config file. Competitors pay an agency $3k a site.

levers.title: Film every job: 20 photos and one 60-second vertical
levers.impact: ~400 pieces of proof in twelve months that nobody can replicate.
